items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I worked a couple of weeks with a fellow known as Cuban Pete at the Ambassador

ctx.x: I did some gigs with different musicians and later wne into the "Reve" a dance hall in the Rex theater building with Charlie "Dizzy" Lewis who had also engaged George Johnson on alto-sax.

After a month at the "Reve", I worked a couple of weeks with a fellow known as Cuban Pete at the Ambassador where I had worked with Willie Lewis after I came back from India in 1937. Pete was an Algerian but most people didn't play an instrument but he was as smooth operator and had collaborated with his pianist and had published some music under his own name. The music that Cuban Pete's orchestra played was Cuban style with not a touch of jazz and I had to wear the Cuban type of shirt that all Cuban and many…

I was supposed to have played a concert in a town called Limoges with Edouard's band and Don Byas before the band broke up, but missed the gig because I thought that I knew how to get the railroad station we were to leave from with the metro.(subway) I did get to the station which was gare d' Austerlitz, but too late for the train the others had taken because I went the wrong direction inthe subway. No one I came in contact with at the station could speak english. I tried to find out if there was another train…
